title: Senior Asterisk Specialist / LATAM
description:
Description

We are looking for a highly experienced Asterisk Specialist to join our Level 3 technical support team. This role combines deep hands-on development, tactical guidance, and partner engagement across our technical team. You will be the go-to expert for complex Asterisk core system troubleshooting and custom telephony solutions, working directly with customers and resellers while supporting our internal development teams. This role focuses on Asterisk's underlying engine, custom dialplan development, and advanced VoIP implementations


English fluency is a MUST for this role! Only candidates with level C1 or C2 will be considered:


A1 Beginner

A2 Elementary

B1 Intermediate

B2 Upper-Intermediate

C1 Advanced

C2 Proficient


Responsibilities
  • Diagnose and resolve complex Asterisk configuration file and dialplan issues.
  • Troubleshoot core Asterisk functionality , channel drivers, and application problems.
  • Elevate telephony engineering skills across our team through mentorship, collaboration, and exemplification.
  • Support development teams with Asterisk AGI, AMI, and ARI integrations.
  • Assist with custom Asterisk builds , patches, and telephony application development.
  • Collaborate closely with technical teams across the enterprise to help transform complex telephony data into actionable insights.
  • Debug complex dialplan logic and custom Asterisk applications using full logs and real-time traces.
  • Optimize Asterisk performance , memory usage, and concurrent call handling for high-performance architecture.
  • Create and maintain detailed documentation for Asterisk configuration patterns and troubleshooting procedures.
  • Establish team coding standards and best practices for dialplan programming and API integration.
  • Participate in our on-call schedule to help ensure availability of critical Asterisk core system services.
  • Provide advanced technical guidance to customers and resellers on custom Asterisk implementations.


Requirements
  • 8+ years of experience in engineering , including senior or lead experience in telephony environments.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience specifically with Asterisk configuration file management and dialplan development.
  • Deep expertise in Asterisk internals , including dialplan programming, channel configuration, and application development.
  • Advanced VoIP knowledge , covering SIP protocol internals, RTP, codec negotiation, and NAT handling.
  • Strong experience with Linux system administration and command-line expertise.
  • Proficiency in Asterisk debugging using CLI commands, logging levels, and protocol analysis.
  • Experience with custom development , specifically AGI scripts, custom applications, and API integrations.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and working within AWS cloud infrastructure services.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex telephony concepts to non-technical audiences.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred qualifications include Asterisk module development in C, scripting expertise (Python, Perl, PHP), and database integration (Realtime, CDR)

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

title: POWER BI DEVELOPER
description:
In addition to the experience listed in the JD, manager stated:

  • it would be \"nice to have\" if a candidate had CPG experience.
  • it would be \"really nice to have\" if a candidate had CPG, supply chain/finance experience.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience with BI solution development and Power BI Datasets, including DAX and data modeling, data mart and data warehouse architecture
  • 5+ years of demonstrated experience in building and driving business adoption of OLAP Cubes using SSRS, SSAS (MDX), and Azure Analysis Services Cubes
  • 5+ years of data analysis in SQL, data cleansing and processing in Python and other languages
  • 15+ years of experience developing and modernizing Business Intelligence architecture, guiding development teams to best in class solutions that are scalable and performant in an Enterprise space.
  • Proficient and experienced in understanding Semantic models, underlying Data lake and data models and BI DW methodologies
  • Experience in highlighting the trends and relationships, causations, and other relationships through the Visualizations
  • Hands on experience and familiarity with storage and compute services in Azure, Azure SQL Server, building data processing pipelines and building reports/cubes on SSRS and SSAS
  • Knowledge on SQL/NoSQL databases, microservices and REST APIs, docker
  • Strong Knowledge on source code management, configuration management, CI/CD, security and performance.
  • Ability to look ahead to identify opportunities and thrive in a culture of innovation
  • Self-starter who can see the big picture, and prioritize your work to make the largest impact on the business’ and customer’s vision and requirements
  • Experience in building, testing, and deploying code to run on Snowflake cloud datalake
  • A can-do attitude in anticipating and resolving problems to help your team to achieve its goals.
  • Must have experience in Agile development methods

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior PHP
description:
Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior PHP 


Somos uma plataforma que ajuda investidores a encontrarem as melhores oportunidades de investimentos. Temos como base a filosofia Buy And Hold (Investimento de longo prazo). Trazemos para nossos usuários informações como: cotações, balanços, comparadores, históricos financeiros das empresas, gráficos, cursos, gerenciador de carteiras, entre outras funcionalidades. Lançada em dezembro de 2020, a plataforma vem tendo um ótimo crescimento, mensalmente já são mais de 18 milhões de pageviews acessadas.


Estamos procurando um desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior para se juntar à nossa equipe de desenvolvimento. Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia, possui sólida experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos web, é especialista em PHP (Laravel) e tem boa experiência em Front-End com HTML, CSS e Javascript, esta pode ser a oportunidade ideal para você.


Escopo de atividades


  • Criação de ferramentas como: comparador de ações, gerenciador de investimentos (carteiras), calculadoras de investimentos, gráficos, relatórios, entre outros;
  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web escaláveis e eficientes em PHP;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de desenvolvimento para projetar e implementar novos recursos;
  • Realizar testes para garantir a qualidade do código;
  • Otimizar aplicações para melhorar o desempenho e a usabilidade;
  • Utilizar ferramentas de IA para apoio em desenvolvimento, revisão de código, testes e ganho de produtividade;
  • Contribuir com melhorias contínuas em processos, automações e uso estratégico de novas tecnologias;
  • Manter-se atualizado com as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento e novas tecnologias.


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência comprovada como desenvolvedor back-end em PHP;
  • Experiência comprovada como desenvolvedor front-end em React Native, HTML, CSS e Javascript;
  • Forte experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (por exemplo, MySQL, PostgreSQL);
  • Conhecimento avançado em Laravel;

description:

Contractor

17-24hr USD


Required Skills & Experience


Strong proficiency in Java and GCP services (Cloud run, BigQuery etc.).

6+ years of experience as a Java Engineer

Strong experience with Kubernetes

Enterprise-level application design.

Ability to work in a distributed, international team environment.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


Knowledge of B2B retail systems

Familiarity with order management, pricing systems, and fulfillment workflows.

Experience in multi-region deployments and cloud security best practices.


Job Description


A large fortune 250 retail company headquartered in Memphis, TN is seeking a Senior Java/GCP Engineer located in Mexico to help with an international project.

This initiative focuses on replicating and integrating Mexico and Brazil B2B websites/applications with U.S. systems to create a unified global platform. The goal is to deliver a consistent experience across regions for B2B retail customers. Current Mexico and Brazil sites are in early stages, and the outcome will ensure seamless linkage between all sites.


Responsibilities


Design and develop Java-based applications integrated with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Build scalable, secure solutions for cross-region connectivity.

Collaborate with global teams to align architecture and standards.

Implement best practices for cloud-native development, performance optimization, and security compliance.

Support integration of multiple applications into a unified ecosystem.

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.


Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form .
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a Job Interest Form . After the initial profile review, we will share an assessment , which must be completed within 24 hours . Based on the assessment submission and your responses, we may schedule an interview round .
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements .



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Electrical Engineering Pod Lead - 72132
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Job Overview:

An Electrical Engineering Pod Lead responsible for managing a small team creating simulation-based design problems used to train and evaluate advanced AI models. The role owns problem quality, reproducible environments, and coordination with AI researchers , and requires strong EE domain depth plus hands-on Python, Docker, and basic cloud skills to review and support the pod end-to-end.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership
  • Lead and manage a pod of 4–8 Engineering Design Specialists by assigning tasks, reviewing deliverables, removing blockers, and mentoring on problem design, simulation rigor, and documentation.
  • Act as the main point of contact with AI research teams to translate model feedback into refinements, while running regular syncs, tracking progress, and reporting updates and risks to program leads.
  • Technical Oversight
  • Oversee and approve pod outputs, maintain reproducible Docker-based simulation environments, support cloud infrastructure for simulation/grading,
  • Develop and review Python automation/validation, and proactively resolve dependency, versioning, and reproducibility issues.
  • Problem Design (Individual Contribution)
  • Personally design a portfolio of high-difficulty electrical engineering problems in your chosen subdomain.
  • Set the quality bar and design philosophy for the pod through your own example submissions.


Electrical Engineering Subdomains:

You must have deep expertise in at least one of the following, with working familiarity across others being a strong plus:

  • Analog / Mixed-Signal IC Design — op-amp topologies, ADC/DAC design, noise analysis, layout-aware design, SPICE-level simulation.
  • Power Electronics — DC-DC converters, inverter design, magnetics sizing, thermal management, efficiency optimization.
  • RF / Microwave Engineering — filter design, impedance matching, S-parameter analysis, transmission line and antenna design.
  • Digital Systems / FPGA / ASIC — RTL design, timing closure, synthesis-aware design, hardware-software co-design.
  • Embedded Systems — microcontroller/DSP-based design, real-time constraints, peripheral interfacing, power budgeting.


Required Qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of hands-on electrical engineering design experience, with a track record of owning designs from specification through validated implementation.
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a technical lead, senior engineer, or team coordination role.
  • Proficiency with Python for scripting, automation, and simulation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker: building images, writing Dockerfiles, managing containerized environments.
  • Familiarity with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — comfortable running workloads, managing storage, and monitoring jobs.
  • Proficiency with at least one open-source EE simulation tool (e.g., ngspice, PySpice, Qucs, OpenEMS, scikit-rf, or similar).


Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience designing engineering coursework, exam problems, or design challenges at graduate level.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines or automated testing frameworks.
  • Exposure to LLM evaluation, AI benchmarking, or training data curation.
  • Cross-domain familiarity with Control Systems, Embedded/Robotics, or Power Systems.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Hiring for Sr. Project Manager | Long Term Contract | Remote


Role: Sr. Project Manager

Initial Duration: Long Term Contract

Remote / EST Time zone (Nearshore Candidates)


Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Client is in need of a versatile Sr. Project Manager, to assist in a number of different projects, within the PMO. These will consist of both application and infrastructure projects, moreso slanting towards applications.

Must:

  • Strong Project Management
  • Able to manage variety of projects, including ERP, Application and Infrastructure projects

  • preferably in a waterfall environment, but broader experience is welcome.
  • Strong Communication
  • Skilled at engaging stakeholders across all levels and functions, with the ability to create clear documentation and straightforward status updates.
  • Risk & Budget Management
  • Expertise in mitigating risks proactively and managing budgets/resources effectively.
  • Leadership Ability to lead cross-functional teams and drive accountability with a bias toward action.

Nice-to-have:

  • PMP Certification
  • Specialty Chemical Industry experience
  • Brazil-based, Portuguese speaking

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Backend Engineer (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview:


As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will play a key role in the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions to support the company's mission and goals. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities:


  • Platform Development: Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Database Development: Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes
  • API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.
  • Security Compliance: Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities:


  • Mentor junior developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to planning, daily stand-ups, and continuous collaboration to ensure timely delivery of high-quality software.



Competencies/Requirements:


  • Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL. Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git.
  • Experience: At least 5 years of experience in backend development, with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Representante de desenvolvimento de vendas
description:
Descrição do Cargo Estamos em busca de um Representante de Desenvolvimento de Vendas (SDR) para integrar a equipe da Metacare. Este cargo envolve identificar e qualificar potenciais clientes para um software na área da saúde, gerenciar leads e desenvolver oportunidades de negócios. Suas responsabilidades diárias incluirão realizar contatos iniciais, manter relacionamento com prospects e colaborar com a equipe de vendas para impulsionar o crescimento. Este é um cargo remoto e baseado em contrato.

Qualificações


  • Inside Sales e Geração de Leads: Experiência com vendas internas e identificação de leads qualificados para ampliar a base de clientes.

  • Desenvolvimento de Negócios e Vendas: Conhecimento em estratégias de vendas e desenvolvimento empresarial para alcançar e superar metas estabelecidas.
  • Além das habilidades mencionadas, será considerado um diferencial experiência com ferramentas de CRM, fluência em outros idiomas e capacidade analítica para identificar oportunidades de mercado.

description:
Video Editor Team Lead

Type: Remote, Full-time (Required)

Availability: Immediate

Location: Latin America

Company: Elevate Group USA LLC.

Required: Fill out the form below to be considered.


About Us

At Elevate Group USA LLC, we are an international e-commerce brand with a mission to deliver exceptional products to a global audience. We believe in innovation, data-driven strategies, and building a remote team of talented individuals who are smart, reliable, and passionate about results.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a Video Editor Team Lead who can not only deliver high-quality video content but also lead, mentor, and elevate a team of video editors. This role requires a balance of creative excellence, operational discipline, and leadership.

You will be responsible for ensuring the team meets creative standards, delivers on time, and continuously improves. If you are a natural leader who takes ownership and knows how to get the best out of people, this role is for you.

  • Video Editing Expertise: Proven experience in video editing for social media, e-commerce, or marketing content (portfolio required).

  • Software Proficiency: Advanced knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, or equivalent editing tools.
  • English Proficiency: Excellent written and spoken English for team coordination and reporting.



Bonus (Not mandatory but valued)

  • Experience with UGC (User-Generated Content) style video production.
  • Basic knowledge of motion graphics or sound design.
  • Familiarity with AI tools for creative optimization.
  • Experience working with e-commerce or direct-to-consumer brands.



What We Offer

  • Monthly base pay in USD.
  • 100% remote work environment.
  • Leadership role with real ownership and impact.
  • Opportunity to build and shape a growing creative team.
  • Direct collaboration with leadership and strategy teams.



How to Apply

Complete the form below (Mandatory).

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
About The Product

At Boldin , we believe financial confidence should be accessible to everyone. Money decisions shape our lives, yet too often people are left without the clarity or tools they need to make informed choices. We exist to change that. Boldin is a comprehensive financial planning platform that helps people understand their financial picture, make smarter decisions with their money and time, and plan for the future with confidence.

With over $20M raised and strong momentum, Boldin is entering a pivotal phase of growth. This is an opportunity to join a mission-driven team and help shape the future.


About This Role

The Principal Data Engineer is a senior technical authority responsible for defining Boldin’s data architecture, setting long-term technical strategy, and tackling our most complex data engineering challenges. This role shapes company-wide data standards, and partners with executive and cross-functional leaders to ensure our data platform scales with the business.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Define and evolve long-term data architecture and vision
  • Design resilient and scalable data platform and pipelines
  • Set standards for data modeling, reliability, observability, and governance
  • Lead complex, high-risk technical initiatives and migrations
  • Influence tool selection, and technology adoption across the data stack
  • Elevate engineering excellence
  • Partner with leadership to align data strategy and business goals
  • Enable analytics, ML, and product use cases 1KPIS + Targets
  • Uptime: Consistently meets SLA for business-critical pipelines
  • Freshness: All Tier 1 datasets delivered within SLA
  • Delivery predictability: Majority of sprint commitments completed as planned
  • Cost optimization: Year-over-year efficiency improvement as data scales
  • Documentation: Full coverage for all production-grade assets


Qualifications

Technical Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 10+ years of experience in data engineering or related disciplines
  • Proficient in SQL, Python, or related languages
  • Cloud Platforms (AWS, GCP)
  • Strong experience with data warehouse, data lakes, and distributed systems
  • Strong experience with modern data stack (Athena, BigQuery, Glue, Spark, Dataproc, Kafka, Flink, dbt, Kestra, Fivetran or equivalent)
  • Proven ability to build and maintain production-grade ELT/ETL pipelines
  • Experience with workflow orchestration (e.g., Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, Cloud Composer)
  • Experience implementing data quality and observability frameworks
  • Performance and cost optimization in cloud warehouses
  • Good spoken English


Product & Business Partnership:

  • Experience supporting product analytics and experimentation
  • Ability to translate business requirements into scalable data models
  • Strong ownership and accountability for SLAs


Nice to Have:

  • Experience working with Kubernetes
  • Experience structuring data for ML or AI use cases
  • Familiarity with Amplitude or product event pipelines
  • Experience in a high-growth SaaS or fintech environment
  • Influencing technical direction without direct managerial authority


Benefits:

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

With over $20M raised and strong momentum, Boldin is entering a pivotal phase of growth. This is an opportunity to join a mission-driven team and help shape the future.


About This Role

The Principal Data Engineer is a senior technical authority responsible for defining Boldin’s data architecture, setting long-term technical strategy, and tackling our most complex data engineering challenges. This role shapes company-wide data standards, and partners with executive and cross-functional leaders to ensure our data platform scales with the business.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Define and evolve long-term data architecture and vision
  • Design resilient and scalable data platform and pipelines
  • Set standards for data modeling, reliability, observability, and governance
  • Lead complex, high-risk technical initiatives and migrations
  • Influence tool selection, and technology adoption across the data stack
  • Elevate engineering excellence
  • Partner with leadership to align data strategy and business goals
  • Enable analytics, ML, and product use cases 1KPIS + Targets
  • Uptime: Consistently meets SLA for business-critical pipelines
  • Freshness: All Tier 1 datasets delivered within SLA
  • Delivery predictability: Majority of sprint commitments completed as planned
  • Cost optimization: Year-over-year efficiency improvement as data scales
  • Documentation: Full coverage for all production-grade assets


Qualifications

Technical Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 10+ years of experience in data engineering or related disciplines
  • Proficient in SQL, Python, or related languages
  • Cloud Platforms (AWS, GCP)
  • Strong experience with data warehouse, data lakes, and distributed systems
  • Strong experience with modern data stack (Athena, BigQuery, Glue, Spark, Dataproc, Kafka, Flink, dbt, Kestra, Fivetran or equivalent)
  • Proven ability to build and maintain production-grade ELT/ETL pipelines
  • Experience with workflow orchestration (e.g., Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, Cloud Composer)
  • Experience implementing data quality and observability frameworks
  • Performance and cost optimization in cloud warehouses
  • Good spoken English


Product & Business Partnership:

  • Experience supporting product analytics and experimentation
  • Ability to translate business requirements into scalable data models
  • Strong ownership and accountability for SLAs


Nice to Have:

  • Experience working with Kubernetes
  • Experience structuring data for ML or AI use cases
  • Familiarity with Amplitude or product event pipelines
  • Experience in a high-growth SaaS or fintech environment
  • Influencing technical direction without direct managerial authority


Benefits:

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Video Editor
description:
Flixr is a trailblazer in creating high-impact social video content, predominantly for mobile games and apps aiming to make a mark in the digital domain. Catering chiefly to performance advertisers, we craft compelling video narratives that not only resonate with target audiences but significantly elevate brand engagement and recognition. At Flixr, a culture of relentless creativity drives us to continually push the envelope, ensuring each project we undertake transcends ordinary and leaves a lasting imprint on the viewer.


Responsibilities

Flixr works with a team of ~20 part time editors to edit ads. We deliver footage and instructions, for you to edit the videos.


All our editors are in our Discord server and fast communication is very important to us.


When a video is ready to be edited, we announce it on a Discord channel, any editor can then accept the job if they want it (they can work as much or as little as they want).


For anyone applying, I'll send one ad for editing as an exercise - if it gets approved, we'll add you :)


Please spend no more than 1 hour on the assessment (even if you submit an unfinished 15 second video, rather than the full 30 second video)


When submitting the assessment, please include your hourly rate and how long the full video would take to complete
company: Flixr - Creative Velocity for Paid Media.

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack PHP/Vue SR/Especialista
description:
A Tech For TI está com oportunidade para Desenvolvedor Full Stack PHP/Vue Sr , atuar em projeto de cliente AutoTech, focada no mercado B2B, presente em diversos países.

  • PJ
  • Remoto


Se interessou? Envie seu currículo também para:


Sobre a Posição

Buscamos um desenvolvedor Full Stack experiente e versátil para integrar nossa equipe de tecnologia, focado na manutenção e evolução de sistema legado de alta demanda. O profissional ideal deve ter uma mentalidade orientada a soluções e disposição para trabalhar tanto com tecnologias frontend modernas e legadas quanto com diferentes versões do PHP em um ambiente tecnológico heterogêneo.


O candidato ideal deve ser capaz de equilibrar a manutenção de código legado com a implementação gradual de melhorias, tanto no frontend quanto no backend, mantendo sempre a estabilidade do sistema em produção. Valorizamos profissionais que vejam sistemas legados como oportunidades de aprendizado e evolução tecnológica.


Requisitos imprescindíveis:


Backend

- Sólida experiência com PHP, incluindo domínio das versões 5.6 e 7.0;

- Proficiência em MySQL 5.6, incluindo otimização de queries e performance;

- Experiência com Docker e containerização;

- Domínio de Git e boas práticas de controle de versão;

- Experiência com sistemas de cache, especialmente Redis;

- Desejável conhecimentos em Google Cloud Platform.


Frontend

- Experiência sólida com Vue.js e seus ecossistemas (Se encontrar com as outras características exceto esta, pode nos enviar mesmo assim);

- Domínio de JavaScript;

- Experiência com jQuery em sistemas legados;

- Conhecimentos em HTML5 e CSS3;

- Experiência com integração de APIs RESTful.


Diferenciais:

- Experiência prévia com sistemas de alta demanda;

- Conhecimentos em práticas de CI/CD;

- Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis;

- Experiência em modernização gradual de sistemas legados;

- Conhecimentos em arquitetura de software;

- Experiência com testes automatizados (PHPUnit, Jest);

- Conhecimentos em UI/UX e design responsivo;


Principais atividades:

- Manter e aprimorar sistema legado de alto tráfego;

- Desenvolver novas funcionalidades utilizando Vue.js;

- Realizar a manutenção de códigos legados em jQuery;

- Implementar melhorias de performance e segurança;

- Realizar refatorações estratégicas mantendo a estabilidade do sistema;

- Colaborar na modernização gradual do código frontend e backend;

- Participar ativamente do planejamento técnico;

- Documentar alterações e processos técnicos;

- Mentor técnico para desenvolvedores menos experientes;

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

title: Senior Collections Policy Analyst
description:
Senior Collections Policy Analyst


What You’ll Do


  • Analyze the behavior of customers with short-, medium-, and long-term delinquencies to identify opportunities for improvement;
  • Create and refine data-driven collections policies to reduce risk and increase recovery;
  • Use SQL and Python to extract insights and generate strategic reports;
  • Explain to the business and sales teams why analytical strategies work and demonstrate the value of the solutions;
  • Work closely with the Data Science and Operations teams.


What we’re looking for


  • Experience: Previous experience with data analysis focused on collections or credit risk;
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL, BigQuery, and Python;
  • Practical Approach: Ability to translate numbers into actions that solve customer problems;
  • Communication: Ability to explain complex results in a simple way to different teams;
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or related fields.


Differentiators


  • Knowledge of discount policies, portfolio write-offs, and pricing
  • English


------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Analista Sénior de Políticas de Cobranças


O que irá fazer


  • Analisar o comportamento dos clientes com incumprimentos a curto, médio e longo prazo para identificar oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Criar e aperfeiçoar políticas de cobranças baseadas em dados para reduzir o risco e aumentar a recuperação;
  • Utilizar SQL e Python para extrair insights e gerar relatórios estratégicos;
  • Explicar às equipas comerciais e de vendas por que razão as estratégias analíticas funcionam e demonstrar o valor das soluções;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipas de Ciência de Dados e Operações.


O que procuramos


  • Experiência: Experiência anterior em análise de dados focada em cobranças ou risco de crédito;
  • Competências técnicas: Proficiência em SQL, BigQuery e Python;
  • Abordagem prática: Capacidade de traduzir números em ações que resolvam os problemas dos clientes;
  • Comunicação: Capacidade de explicar resultados complexos de forma simples a diferentes equipas;
  • Formação: Licenciatura em Matemática, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas afins.


Diferenciais


  • Conhecimento de políticas de descontos, baixas de carteira e precificação;
  • Inglês.

title: Credit Risk Analyst
description:
Credit Risk Analyst — Acquisition & Online Lending

Full-time Contractor (PJ) | 100% Remote | US Central Time hours


⚠️ This is NOT an FP&A, Treasury, or Controller role. If your background is financial planning, accounting, or back-book portfolio management, this role is not a match.


Our US fintech client — an online consumer lender — is looking for a Credit Risk Analyst who owns the front end of the credit funnel. This means acquisition-side risk: designing risk tiers, sequencing underwriting decisions, managing approval/decline trade-offs at the top of funnel, and building the logic that determines who gets credit and at what terms — before any loan hits the books.


If you have hands-on experience with risk tiers, underwriting decision paths, dynamic acquisition pricing, or rescue lane strategies at an online lender, BNPL provider, or fintech — this role is built for you.


What You'll Do

• Optimize risk tiers and underwriting sequences for online customer acquisition

• Analyze precision/recall trade-offs in credit decisioning models to balance approval volume and loss rates

• Support or develop dynamic acquisition pricing strategies tied to risk performance

• Design and refine multiple underwriting pathways (multi-path sequencing)

• Build and monitor rescue lane strategies to recover near-miss applicants

• Track and report on front-end risk KPIs: approval rate, take rate, early delinquency, cost per funded loan

• Work closely with data and product teams to improve decision engine logic


Requirements (Non Negotiable)

• 3+ years of experience in online consumer lending, BNPL, or a tangential fintech/e-commerce credit environment

• Hands-on acquisition/top-of-funnel risk experience: risk tier assessment, underwriting sequencing, or dynamic acquisition pricing

• Fluent English — interviews, daily standups, and all written communication are in English

• SQL proficiency — comfortable writing queries independently to analyze credit performance data

• Ability to work US Central Time hours (approx. 9am–6pm CT / 11am–8pm Brasília)


Nice to Have

• Experience with rescue lane management or near-miss recovery programs

• Background in fraud risk within the acquisition funnel

• Exposure to multi-path underwriting logic or decision engine configuration

• Portfolio monitoring and credit loss forecasting (post-acquisition)

• Experience at an e-commerce, marketplace lending, or embedded finance company


What We Offer

• PJ/contractor arrangement — compensation aligned with fintech market rates

• 100% remote — work from anywhere in Brazil

• US Central Time schedule — structured workday, no late nights

• Direct exposure to a fast-growing US online lending operation


To apply, fill out the questions below. Responses in Portuguese will not be considered.

• Work closely with data and product teams to improve decision engine logic


Requirements (Non Negotiable)

• 3+ years of experience in online consumer lending, BNPL, or a tangential fintech/e-commerce credit environment

• Hands-on acquisition/top-of-funnel risk experience: risk tier assessment, underwriting sequencing, or dynamic acquisition pricing

• Fluent English — interviews, daily standups, and all written communication are in English

• SQL proficiency — comfortable writing queries independently to analyze credit performance data

• Ability to work US Central Time hours (approx. 9am–6pm CT / 11am–8pm Brasília)


Nice to Have

• Experience with rescue lane management or near-miss recovery programs

• Background in fraud risk within the acquisition funnel

• Exposure to multi-path underwriting logic or decision engine configuration

• Portfolio monitoring and credit loss forecasting (post-acquisition)

• Experience at an e-commerce, marketplace lending, or embedded finance company


What We Offer

• PJ/contractor arrangement — compensation aligned with fintech market rates

• 100% remote — work from anywhere in Brazil

• US Central Time schedule — structured workday, no late nights

• Direct exposure to a fast-growing US online lending operation


To apply, fill out the questions below. Responses in Portuguese will not be considered.

title: Customer Service Technical Support
description:
Company Description

Kyniska is a leading provider of innovative HR solutions, connecting talented individuals with exciting job opportunities worldwide. Our dedicated consultants collaborate with top companies globally, offering industry insights while mentoring and training candidates. Every day, we help over 200,000 professionals achieve fulfilling careers tailored to their skills and aspirations. At Kyniska, we are committed to enabling professional growth and creating impactful employment connections.

Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Customer Service Technical Support professional. Responsibilities include delivering exceptional customer support, ensuring customer satisfaction, and enhancing customer experience through proficient problem-solving and communication. The individual will handle customer inquiries via phone, email, or chat, troubleshoot technical issues, and work diligently to resolve customer concerns while maintaining professional and empathetic interaction.

Qualifications
  • Strong skills in Customer Service and Customer Support, ensuring the ability to manage and resolve client inquiries efficiently.
  • Expertise in Customer Satisfaction and Customer Experience, with a focus on delivering solutions to improve customer relationships.
  • Proficiency in Phone Etiquette and effective communication skills, providing a professional and empathetic approach to customer interactions.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while being a collaborative team player.
  • Problem-solving aptitude and a keen attention to detail, especially in handling technical customer issues.
  • A background in IT, technical support, or related fields is a valuable asset.
  • Experience using CRM or help desk software is a plus.

title: Siebel Consultant
description:
A PrimeIT é uma empresa de referência, com 18 anos de experiência na prestação de serviços tecnológicos de IT, Telecomunicações e Engenharia.


Especializados em Team Extension, Managed Services, Custom Software e Nearshore, contamos actualmente com uma equipa de mais de 2350 profissionais que colaboram em projectos nacionais e internacionais nas mais diversas tecnologias.


Estamos à procura de um Siebel Consultant!


O que procuramos?

  • Mais de 2 anos de experiência em Siebel (8.1.x) , com foco em desenvolvimento e manutenção de soluções CRM.
  • Experiência em PL/SQL para desenvolvimento e otimização de queries e procedimentos em bases de dados Oracle.
  • Conhecimentos de IBM DataStage para processos ETL e integração de dados.
  • Experiência em Shell Script em ambientes Unix/Linux para automação e suporte a processos aplicacionais.


Responsabilidades:

  • Realizar análise, desenho, implementação e testes de melhorias e correções no CRM One.
  • Avaliar impactos técnicos e funcionais nas aplicações Siebel (8.1.15) e nos processos ETL em DataStage .
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas de software , assegurando conformidade com requisitos funcionais e técnicos.
  • Colaborar com equipas funcionais e operacionais na implementação de evoluções solicitadas.


O que oferecemos?

  • Integração numa empresa de dimensão internacional com presença em mais de 50 cidades no mundo;
  • Formação constante nas mais recentes e inovadoras tecnologias – Prime Academy;
  • Acompanhamento e progressão de carreira.


  • Envia o teu CV e junta-te à equipa Prime!

description:
No seu dia a dia você irá atuar com:


  • Participar ativamente no desenvolvimento de produtos desde a concepção até a implantação e acompanhamento em produção;
  • Contribuir na modelagem e na evolução de nossas soluções, respondendo a requisitos de performance e robustez, entre outros;
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento do nosso sistema de gerenciamento de ordens (OMS), algoritmos de execução e soluções de baixa latência;

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia de Computação, Eletrônica, Sistemas de Informação, Informática ou área técnica relacionada;

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento com .NET/C#;
  • Proatividade e capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa em uma equipe multidisciplinar;

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento front-end e React;

title: Back-End Technical Lead
description:
At OSF Digital , we are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Back-End Technical Lead to drive the design, development, and optimization of scalable server-side solutions.

The ideal candidate will lead a team of back-end developers, ensure technical excellence across projects, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-performance and reliable digital applications aligned with business goals.


Responsibilities:

Lead and mentor a team of back-end developers, providing technical guidance and performance support.

Design and implement robust, scalable, and high-performance back-end architectures.

Oversee server-side logic, database design and maintenance, ensuring responsiveness to front-end requests.

Ensure code quality, consistency, and maintainability through code reviews and best practices.

Collaborate with Project Managers, Front-End Developers, DevOps, and other stakeholders to achieve project objectives.

Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize applications for performance and scalability.

Contribute to technical documentation, including architecture and design specifications.

Act as the primary technical point of contact for back-end development topics.

Stay up to date with emerging back-end technologies and assess their applicability to ongoing and future projects.


Requirements:

Proven experience as a Back-End Developer with a strong track record of successful project delivery.

Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring development teams.

Strong knowledge of back-end programming languages such as Java, Python, Ruby, or .NET.

Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases and web server technologies.

Solid understanding of RESTful APIs and microservices architecture.

Proficiency with version control tools such as Git.

Strong understanding of server-side logic, scalability, and performance optimization.

Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred.

Fluency in English is required.


Benefits:

Discover OSF’s benefits and programs!

title: Supply Chain Planning Solution Partner (Brazil) – Remote (Contract Role)
description:
Supply Chain Planning Solution Partner (Brazil)

Location:  Brazil (Remote)

Employment Type:  Contract

Compensation:  Commission-only


About Us

Streamline is an AI‑native, collaborative planning platform that helps manufacturers, distributors, and retailers forecast demand, optimize inventory, and align S&OP in real time. The cloud platform is localized in 13 languages and supports 1,200+ customers across 35 countries. G2 reviewers rank Streamline the #1 Most Implementable solution, delivering go‑lives up to 10× faster than legacy suites.


About the Role

We are seeking motivated Solution Partners  based in Brazil  to join our expanding team. This is a commission-based contract role , ideal for individuals looking to enter the supply chain technology or consulting space and develop commercial expertise while working independently.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and connect with potential clients across the supply chain, logistics, or manufacturing sectors.
  • Introduce Streamline’s supply chain solutions and articulate their value to business decision-makers.
  • Collaborate with our sales and product teams to support client onboarding and ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Build and maintain relationships that drive long-term success and partnership growth.

Requirements

  • Background or education in supply chain, logistics, or related fields .
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and goal-oriented.
  • Fluent in Portuguese  (English proficiency is a plus).
  • No prior experience required  – we provide onboarding and support.

What We Offer

  • Commission-only compensation  with competitive earning potential.
  • Flexible, remote work  setup.
  • Opportunity to represent a globally trusted supply chain optimization solution.
  • Comprehensive onboarding and continuous support from our global team.

Join Us

If you’re ready to take the first step in building a career in supply chain solutions and thrive in an independent, performance-driven role - we’d love to hear from you.


Apply now  to become part of Streamline’s growing global partner network.

title: Back-End Developer Golang  SR
description:
Descrição da vaga

Enquanto desenvolvedor sênior, será esperado de você uma capacidade técnica e analítica profunda sobre o que já foi implementado no projeto.

você será uma referencia técnica no time, e deverá exercer certa influencia de liderança. Deverá ser demandado, na maior parte do tempo, em caráter de auxiliador de desenvolvedores mais júniores e, por isso, o comprometimento com a inovação e aquisição de conhecimento dentro do universo Android se faz

essencial para o seu nível de carreira.

Responsabilidades e atribuições



  • Atuar com profunda capacidade técnica e analítica sobre o que já foi implementado no projeto, garantindo evolução contínua das soluções;
  • Ser referência técnica dentro do time, exercendo influência de liderança e apoiando desenvolvedores mais júniores;
  • Contribuir diretamente para inovação e aquisição de conhecimento no ecossistema Android e demais tecnologias envolvidas;
  • Desenvolver e manter APIs REST de alta performance;
  • Projetar e implementar serviços resilientes, escaláveis e tolerantes a falhas;
  • Atuar na otimização de latência, throughput e desempenho de sistemas de alta volumetria;
  • Implementar estratégias avançadas de caching, incluindo Redis distribuído;
  • Aplicar rate limiting, circuit breaker e mecanismos de backpressure;
  • Realizar profiling e tuning de aplicações para máxima eficiência;
  • Trabalhar em modelagem de banco de dados orientada à performance e escalabilidade;
  • Atuar com bancos relacionais e não relacionais, conforme as demandas do projeto;
  • Trabalhar com arquitetura de microsserviços em produção, garantindo consistência e disponibilidade;
  • Implementar práticas de observabilidade, monitoramento e tracing distribuído;
  • Atuar com Docker, Kubernetes e ambientes cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure).




Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência avançada com Golang;
  • Profundo entendimento de concorrência com goroutines, channels e context;
  • Experiência comprovada na construção de APIs REST de alta performance;
  • Sólido conhecimento no design de serviços resilientes e escaláveis;
  • Vivência com sistemas de alta volumetria (milhares ou milhões de requisições);
  • Conhecimento em otimização de latência e throughput;
  • Experiência com estratégias de caching, especialmente Redis distribuído;
  • Domínio de técnicas como rate limiting, circuit breaker e backpressure;
  • Habilidade em profiling e tuning de aplicações;
  • Experiência com bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL/MySQL);
  • Experiência com bancos não relacionais (MongoDB ou similares);
  • Prática com microsserviços em produção e fundamentos de sistemas distribuídos (consistência, tolerância a falhas, observabilidade);
  • Experiência com monitoramento, logging e tracing distribuído;
  • Conhecimento em Docker e Kubernetes;
  • Vivência com cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure).

title: Engenheiro(a) de Software FullStack .NET
description:
Sobre a Empresa

Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo:

Engenheiro(a) de Software FullStack .NET

Atuação: Desenvolvimento e Suporte

Idioma obrigatório: Inglês avançado/C1


Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Software FullStack .NET , com foco em desenvolvimento front-end e back-end, suporte evolutivo e sustentação de integrações críticas de sistemas de faturamento.

Esse(a) profissional participará ativamente do desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, manutenção de aplicações corporativas de grande escala e da iniciativa de migração para a nuvem , contribuindo em um ambiente dinâmico, colaborativo e orientado à evolução contínua.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e suporte de aplicações full-stack.
  • Desenvolver novas funcionalidades em aplicações web corporativas.
  • Apoiar a sustentação e evolução de sistemas legados, quando necessário.
  • Participar de iniciativas de modernização tecnológica e migração para a nuvem.
  • Colaborar com times multifuncionais, garantindo alinhamento técnico e de negócio.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência de 4 a 6 anos em desenvolvimento full-stack para aplicações corporativas de grande escala.
  • Experiência prática com ASP.NET MVC utilizando C# .
  • Experiência com tecnologias de front-end como React, Angular ou Blazor .
  • Forte proficiência em SQL para consultas e extração de dados.
  • Sólido entendimento dos princípios S.O.L.I.D e sua aplicação no design de software.
  • Inglês avançado (C1) obrigatório , com uso frequente em comunicação escrita e verbal.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com mecanismos de autenticação e autorização, como OAuth2 .
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CI/CD , como Azure DevOps ou GitHub Actions .
  • Proficiência com sistemas de controle de versão, como Git .
  • Experiência prática na implantação e manutenção de soluções web no Azure .
  • Conhecimento em logging, monitoramento e diagnóstico em ambientes de nuvem.


Buscamos um perfil que

  • Tenha visão técnica sólida e postura hands-on.
  • Goste de resolver problemas complexos em ambientes corporativos.
  • Esteja confortável em transitar entre desenvolvimento, suporte e evolução arquitetural.
  • Tenha interesse em contribuir com jornadas de modernização e cloud migration.


Benefícios:

Vale Refeição - Cartão Swille

title: Platform Engineer
description:
We're hiring! We are looking for a Platform Engineer based in Brazil to join a team responsible for building and maintaining the infrastructure that powers a growing ecosystem of legal technology products.


This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working across cloud, automation, Kubernetes, GitOps, and observability, helping ensure that the platforms our development teams rely on are reliable, scalable, and secure.


You'll work across Microsoft Azure and on-premises datacenter environments , contributing to a modern hybrid infrastructure with strong focus on infrastructure-as-code, container orchestration, CI/CD, security, and AI-assisted engineering workflows.


We're looking for someone who is highly autonomous, communicates well in English, and is excited about using AI-assisted development tools as part of a modern infrastructure engineering workflow.


Responsibilities

  • Design, provision, and maintain infrastructure across Azure and on-premises environments
  • Manage and support Kubernetes clusters across hybrid environments
  • Build and extend infrastructure automation using Terraform and Ansible
  • Contribute to GitOps-based deployment and environment management workflows
  • Support observability platforms for logs, metrics, dashboards, and alerting
  • Collaborate with development teams to ensure infrastructure is secure, scalable, and aligned with product needs
  • Help maintain CI/CD workflows and improve delivery consistency
  • Contribute to platform reliability, security, and operational excellence
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented infrastructure code and technical documentation
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to improve speed, quality, and delivery


Requirements

  • Strong written and spoken English
  • CNPJ in Brazil + ability to issue monthly Nota Fiscal
  • 3-5 years of professional experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineering
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform
  • Practical experience with Kubernetes in both cloud and on-prem environments
  • Experience with GitOps tools such as ArgoCD or similar
  • Hands-on experience with Ansible for provisioning, automation, and configuration management
  • Good understanding of Azure Landing Zone concepts, including subscriptions, policy, networking, and governance
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar
  • Strong understanding of infrastructure-as-code principles, including state management, module design, and drift detection
  • Experience working with containerized workloads and deployment lifecycle management
  • Good understanding of hybrid infrastructure and networking patterns between on-prem and Azure
  • Working knowledge of Azure Active Directory B2C for identity and access management in multi-tenant environments
  • Familiarity with WAF configuration , security rule management , and least-privilege access patterns
  • Experience with secrets management and certificate handling
  • Hands-on experience with observability tools such as Grafana and Loki
  • Familiarity with metrics aggregation tools such as Grafana Mimir or similar
  • Active use of AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot , Claude Code , or similar
  • Experience using AI tools to accelerate Terraform, Ansible, troubleshooting, documentation, and operational workflows


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Azure Policy , Blueprints , or Defender for Cloud
  • Familiarity with service mesh technologies such as Istio or Linkerd
  • Exposure to compliance-heavy environments such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA
  • Experience in legal tech or other enterprise / compliance-sensitive SaaS environments


What We're Looking For

  • Strong ownership and accountability
  • Clear communication and ability to work directly with technical stakeholders
  • Comfort working independently in a remote environment
  • Someone who cares about reliability, automation, and maintainability
  • An engineer who thinks in systems and wants to understand how all the pieces fit together
  • Genuine interest in how AI is changing infrastructure and software engineering workflows

title: Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the DevOps team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the DevOps and Systems Administration teams.


Key Responsibilities


  • Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment
  • Support GCP workloads, primarily BigQuery pipelines and related data infrastructure.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling.
  • Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including self-hosted runners.
  • Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; CloudWatch; OneUptime).
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.
  • Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones.
  • Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures.


Who You Are


  • 5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, DevOps, or infrastructure support role.
  • Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, CloudFront).
  • Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker).
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions.
  • Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).
  • Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence).


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with GCP, specifically BigQuery and related data services.
  • Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro).
  • Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms.
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps, or DevOps Engineer).
  • Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging.
  • Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

title: SAP Basis Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Company Description

TokenFlow is an onchain token clarity platform. A B2B product, giving protocols complete visibility of their token ecosystem, including: all holder addresses, all transactions and their types, market maker tracking and performance, DeFi positions, and much more.


We're a small, lean team with lots of experience in crypto and tokenomics. We've received funding, and we're looking for our first non-founder hire.



What You'll Do
  • Design and implement scalable backend services and APIs
  • Architect, deploy, and operate cloud-native systems on GCP, AWS, or Azure, optimized for performance, scalability, and reliability
  • Own DevOps workflows end-to-end — CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/Pulumi), container orchestration, and environment management
  • Build, operate, and optimize data ingestion and processing pipelines for high-volume, event-driven workloads
  • Integrate and manage RPC-based data sources, designing resilient systems for rate-limited, high-throughput, and fault-tolerant data access
  • Design, query, and optimize relational databases, with a strong focus on data modeling, indexing, query performance, and schema evolution
  • Monitor and maintain system health — defining SLOs, setting up alerting, and diagnosing performance bottlenecks across services and databases
  • Apply security best practices across services — authentication, authorization, secrets management, input validation, and safe handling of sensitive data
  • Secure APIs and services against common vulnerabilities — injection, broken auth, and unauthorized access
  • Enforce HTTPS and encryption for data in transit and at rest, and apply least-privilege access across services and infrastructure
  • Run security checks in CI/CD pipelines, maintain audit logs for sensitive operations, and set up rate limiting to protect against abuse
  • Maintain a workflow, continuously identify risks, review access controls, patch vulnerabilities, and improve defenses as systems evolve
  • Integrate and secure crypto wallet flows in production — signing, transaction validation, and key management
  • Collaborate across product, data, and infrastructure to ship features end-to-end
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested, and well-documented code


Requirements
  • Previous experience in fullstack, backend-focused software engineering, security engineering, or crypto/web3 development
  • Strong experience building backend services and APIs
  • Solid understanding of relational databases, query optimization, and schema design for performance at scale
  • Experience with DevOps practices including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Familiarity with cloud security fundamentals — secrets management, IAM, network policies, and secure API design
  • Experience securing API routes and endpoints — proper auth middleware, route guards, role-based access control, and scoped permissions
  • Understanding of how to handle sensitive data — PII, tokens, credentials — including encryption at rest, masking in logs, and secure storage practices
  • Experience running and debugging production systems
  • Familiarity with modern frontend frameworks
  • Hands-on experience running and maintaining containerized workloads in cloud environments


    • Nice to Have

    • Experience hardening production systems, database access controls, audit logging, and vulnerability scanning in CI pipelines
    • Familiarity with the crypto industry, including core blockchain concepts and onchain data
    • Experience with data-focused platforms (e.g. Dune Analytics, The Graph) and production-grade RPC node integration and monitoring


    Salary: $36,000 - $42,000 USD

    Fully remote, with preference if based in Brazil.

Descrição da Empresa A HiDesign Estúdio Editorial é especializada na produção de materiais didáticos para o mercado privado, sistemas de ensino e PNLD, atuando há mais de 13 anos no segmento. Nossa equipe combina criatividade e excelência técnica para atender às demandas do mercado editorial com alta qualidade. title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Managerto join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.



Responsibilities

  • Proactively recruit and develop effective local partnerships with merchandise partners, manufacturers, and brands. Focus on categories selections to increase overall value, in alignment with business and customer needs.
  • Assist merchandise partners in establishing themselves on the platform and their growth.Guide merchandise partners in developing comprehensive plans including market positioning, product planning, brand marketing, and operational strategies.
  • Propose innovative ideas based on the current status of the categories, as well as create and implement projects through resource integration and merchant guidance.
  • Conduct industry analysis reports, explore potential customer needs through data analysis, and adjust strategies accordingly based on market trends.


Required skills / Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational experience, including but not limited to experience in brand management or platform operations.
  • Extensive connections and relationships with local seller and vendor networks is a plus.
  • Strong data analysis skills, able to analyze industry trends and project management through data, and summarize conclusions.
  • Possesses market exploration and marketing innovation capabilities, capable of guiding overall merchant marketing plans.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, self-motivation, ability to think strategically and adapt quickly to changes.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage logistics during high-demand periods.


Equal Employment Statement

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.


Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.
